fields.summary_ko.0: Walmart (WMT) gained 11.4% over the past month but declined 7.3% over six months; management aims to expand market share by deploying tariff refunds at lower prices through fiscal 2027.
fields.summary_ko.1: Walmart U.S. revenue growth rate is a key metric to watch in the November Q3 earnings announcement; confirmation is needed on whether the low-price policy translates into increased sales volume.
fields.summary_ko.2: Since the official announcement in August, additional costs from fuel expenses are expected to exceed $2 billion on a fiscal-year basis, a substantial amount relative to the trailing 12-month operating profit of $32.3 billion.
